_comment: Thumbnailer job. Runs on event end / recording completion as a CPU-only task (override the image command: python3 /app/bin/thumbnailer.py, THUMB_CONFIG=/job/thumb.json). Reads the hi-res source from S3, writes poster + storyboard sheets + WebVTT to out_s3, and registers the keys with the control plane. No GPU, no re-encode.
